full_page.content:
1945, December 17
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solenus Casey, C.F.M.Cap.
December 17th 1945.
Mr. and Mrs. Joseph O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Ill.
St. Michael's Church 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N.Y.
Ny Dear Friends: God bless you and yours. Many thanks indeed for your charitable favor noted yesterday. I came just in nice time - especially the smaller cheque - to enroll quite a number of my friends in the Ser Mass Assoc'n for a Christmas gifte. - a double, tripple charity.
Thinking you were down in Texas for the Winter I addressed a letter to you only last week - to Palmer Hotel Ko Allen Texas - the address as - indicated on the baskets of fine fruit that came to us in your name - and for which = want to thank you again - for the twofine baskets of delicious fruit.
You will very likely receive the letter formarded withe relics of V.Nother Hary of Jesus, of Agreda, which had inclosed.
Again thanking you for your many favors I beg to remain Sincerely Yours in the Divine Infant Jesus. Fr. Solanus, O.F.I. Cap.
